properties.title: IFCB Daily Taxonomic Abundance (objects per mL) — WHOI IFCB Data Archive
properties.description: Daily taxon-specific abundance estimates derived from Imaging FlowCytobot (IFCB) instruments in the WHOI IFCB Data Archive. Each daily summary is generated by aggregating per-bin classification outputs over a calendar day and converting classifier results into taxon-specific object concentrations (objects/mL) using a winner-takes-all approach. Metadata typically include sampling location (latitude/longitude), instrument identifier, analyzed volume, classification threshold, and per-taxon abundance. At present, this dataset directory includes MVCO as the first processed site, with additional IFCB sites intended to be added over time.
